title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (May, 2026)
summary: Overview of the May 2026 cumulative updates for Business Central: 28.1 (CU01 for 2026 release wave 1) with cloud and on-premises build numbers, 27.7 and 26.13. It notes that the Admin Center now shows full Country/Region names when creating environments. It also lists on-premises lifecycle dates for all versions.
key_points: Update 28.1 released for 2026 release wave 1, with separate cloud and on-premises platform and application builds
Updates 27.7 (2025 wave 2) and 26.13 (2025 wave 1) also released
The Admin Center now shows full Country/Region names when creating a new environment
On-premises Modern Policy end dates: v28 Oct 2027, v27 Apr 2027, v26 Oct 2026
Versions 15 to 25 and 13 are End of Life; version 14 (Fixed Policy) is past mainstream support, with extended support ending October 2025

quotes.text: When creating a new environment in the Business Central Admin Center, Microsoft now displays the full name of the Country/Region.
quotes.why_it_matters: This user experience improvement makes environment creation clearer and reduces ambiguity when selecting geographic regions for deployment
